name: Xingdeng Yuanye
source:
An Illuminator living in the Starshard Beacon. She is the elder sister of Blessa Comet, the main vocalist of a super-popular band, "Starkiss." She hopes that her singing can guide more newborn Illuminators who are still wandering in the wild.

[spoiler]During the chaos caused by Spectrica's imprisonment, Wishia Comet was entrusted to be the administrator of Starshard Beacon.[/spoiler]

An Illuminator living in the Starshard Beacon. She is the elder sister of Blessa Comet, the main vocalist of a super-popular band, "Starkiss." She hopes that her singing can guide more newborn Illuminators who are still wandering in the wild.
